```text
# PR #3318: Patch: a job ran over 7 minutes

Closes #3314

I made no count change, because the cause of the 7-minute jobs is already fixed on `main`. This PR only adds a comment to `scripts/ci-shards.toml` saying so, so the next bot doesn't raise the count. The real fix is #3305 (PR #3307, `952de68e32`).

## Why no count change

- **The slow part.** `honest_win()` in `crates/server/tests/api/practice.rs` is called by three tests in each of the two `server practice` groups. It waited about 150 s for the slowest game of a batch. #3305's plan measured 154 s of a 154 s group in it.
- **Why the reported run was slow.** Run 42255181617 was on `bot/issue-3290` at `7c20d93`, before `952de68e32`. Its 7m 4s and 7m 10s match #3305's pre-fix 7m 1s. I checked that `952de68e32` is an ancestor of this branch's base.
- **Why a higher count would hurt.** The tests now run in about 5 s, so the rest of each job is compiling the server test binary, which every shard repeats. A higher count would only add runners.
- **It would also turn `bot selftest` red on `main`.** `bot/tests/test_ci_matrix.py::test_the_committed_files_give_todays_jobs` pins every `[rust-test]` count at 1, and the bot may not edit `bot/`. A PR that touches only `scripts/ci-shards.toml` skips `bot selftest`, but `main` and the merge queue run it. #3263 hit this and #3280 had to repair it.
- **Moving the tests into a new binary would drop them.** Both groups pin `--test server`.

## What changed

`scripts/ci-shards.toml` has a five-line comment between `"server api" = 1` and `"server practice" = 1`. It says why the two practice groups stay at 1 and points at #3314 and #3305. Every count is unchanged. No file under `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/` or `.claude/` changed.

## How I tested

- `python3 .github/ci/matrix.py matrix > /dev/null` exited 0 and printed the 16 `rust (test …)` jobs plus the web and e2e shard line.
- `cd bot && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -p test_ci_matrix.py` ran 15 tests, `OK`.
- Both practice groups pass with CI's exact commands:
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server -- api::practice::r`: `27 passed; 0 failed … finished in 5.74s`
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server -- api::practice:: --skip api::practice::r`: `19 passed; 0 failed … finished in 5.12s`
- These are local times on this machine, not CI times. The build was mostly warm (only `thiserror` recompiled), so I did not re-measure the cold compile. The plan's 3m 18s is the planner's number, not mine. I claim nothing about CI times.
- `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `patches check` and `catalog check` pass. `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` printed `classify: Internal`.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/net/ci-scope.test.ts` passed 139 tests. It failed at first because `apps/web/src/wasm/pkg` was not built, so I ran `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`, then it passed.
- I did not run workspace `cargo clippy` or `cargo test`. The diff is a TOML comment, and the harness runs both.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- **Comment only, no count raised.** I rejected raising `"server practice"` or `"server practice rulings"` to 2 or more, for the reasons above.
- **No timing assertion or new test.** A timing assertion in `practice.rs` would be flaky on shared runners. The count guard already exists in `test_ci_matrix.py`.
- **Departure from the plan:** none, apart from the `build-wasm.sh` step I had to add to run the web test.

## For a reviewer to check twice

- **Verify on this PR's CI.** `scripts/ci-scope.sh` runs every Rust group for a change to `scripts/ci-shards.toml`, so this PR's CI is the first run of both practice jobs with the fix. If either `rust (test server practice)` job is still over 7 minutes, the cause is not `honest_win` and #3314 should stay open with the job logs. Otherwise #3314 can be closed once both are under 5 minutes.
- **Seed risk.** `honest_win` is fast only because the first winning seed is among the first few of the first batch. An AI or engine change that moves that seed could make the batch wait on a slow lower seed again. That is outside this issue, and the next `ci duration` report would show it.

## Optional, for a person

This is not needed to close #3314. In `.github/ci/rust-test.toml`, the two `server practice` groups could build the engine and cards at opt-level 1, as `server` and `server api` already do. The planner measured the cold compile dropping from 3m 18s to 2m 40s. I did not re-measure it, and the tests went from about 4–5 s to about 6 s. Append `--config profile.test.package.jackioh-engine.opt-level=1 --config profile.test.package.jackioh-cards.opt-level=1` before ` -- ` on the two `test =` lines at `.github/ci/rust-test.toml:127` and `:133`. The group comment above them, which says the two `server` groups use opt-level 1, would then need to name all four.

### Its own review

Built and checked on `claude-3`. This is a draft while its own review run, on the same subscription, reviews it adversarially and fixes what it finds (up to 3 rounds); CI runs on it meanwhile. Once that review approves it, it is marked ready and auto-merge turns on.

| Round | Builder | Checks | Review |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | build, 10.5 min | green | - |

| Gate | Result | Time |
|---|---|---|
| rustfmt (`cargo fmt --check`) | pass | 6s |
| catalog (`cargo jackioh catalog check`) | pass | 0s |
| patches (`cargo jackioh patches check`) | pass | 1s |
| rulings (`cargo jackioh spec check`) | pass | 3s |
| clippy (`cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`) | pass | 129s |
| cargo tests (`cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire)"`) | pass | 1448s |
| web tests (`sh scripts/build-wasm.sh && pnpm exec vitest run --project web --changed origin/main --exclude '**/src/audio/**' --exclude '**/src/fx/**' --exclude '**/src/cards/art/convention.test.ts'`) | pass | 21s |

</details>
